headline: Enzo Maresca: Man City need to find a 'new Rodri'
description: Manchester City coach Enzo Maresca said the club need to find a "new Rodri" following the departure of their midfield linchpin.

headline: Tottenham thumped by Brentford in EPL opener
description: New-look Spurs show the same old flaws as a rampant Brentford outfit triumph 3-0 on an alarming opening day for Roberto De Zerbi's side.

headline: Herrington's dream start to life in Premier League
description: Teenage Socceroos star Lucas Herrington has made a dream start to life in the Premier League, coming on as a second-half substitute in Hull City's boilover 2-0 victory over giants Manchester United.

headline: Hull City stun Manchester United in historic 2-0 upset
description: Newly promoted Hull City silence the doubters and secure their first ever EPL victory against Manchester United in their return to the top-flight division.
